items.title: Pay patient share for hearing aids
items.quote: Den Betrag erbitten wir innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum auf unser Konto;
items.computation: Private invoice, not from an authority, so the 30-day period runs from the invoice date itself under §§ 187, 188 BGB. The invoice date (19.11.2026) is the triggering event and is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB); counting starts 20.11.2026 as day 1. Day 30 of the period falls on 19.12.2026 (Nov 20-30 = 11 days, Dec 1-19 = 19 days, 11+19=30). 19.12.2026 is a Saturday. Under § 193 BGB, when the last day of a period for a payment falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the period ends on the next working day. The next working day is Monday 21.12.2026 (not a public holiday in NW). Payer is in NW, so NW holidays apply; no NW holiday falls in this window.
